command:
set -uxo pipefail
cd /workspace
git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace
git reset --hard HEAD
git clean -fdx -e .venv -e venv -e __pycache__ || true
rm -f task_module.py task_module.pyc || true
echo YXNzZXJ0IEZhbHNl | base64 -d > test_r2e_0123456789.py
: 'START_TEST_OUTPUT'
python -m pytest test_r2e_0123456789.py -v --no-header || true
: 'END_TEST_OUTPUT'
